Q: Which session entry types and roles count toward tool:Name#n resolution, and what filter on Name is applied? Cite file#section or file#Lx-Ly.
A: Only session entries with type 'message' whose message.role is 'toolResult' and whose toolName is a string count. Name matching is exact string equality; if the name is absent from the results and an alias maps to exactly one target, that target is used. Multiple alias targets fail.
Task: Determine how TaskManage resolves tool:Name#n evidence references in completion answers
